newsitem.title: UK: EMI extends losses on continued U.S. worries.
newsitem.headline: EMI extends losses on continued U.S. worries.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group extended this week's sharp losses on Friday, tumbling 2.25 percent on lingering worries about the company's exposure to the U.S. market and U.S. retailer Musicland, dealers said.
One particularly large order to sell hit the market this morning, they said.
At 1129 GMT, EMI shares were down 28p to 1223-1/2, a 10-week low.
The shares skidded yesterday on fears about the impact of troubles at Musicland, which this week said it had asked record labels for concessions on payments while it sought more cash.
